newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia DCB cuts base rate to 9.20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia DCB cuts base rate to 9.20 pct.

text.p: DCB Bank Bhd, a unit of listed DCB Holdings Bhd, said on Friday it was trimming its base lending rate to 9.20 percent from 9.25 from September 7.
In a statement, the bank said the move was in line with the prevailing interbank rate.
DCB Bank said its fixed deposit rates will remain at 7.10 percent for one month, 7.20 for three months and 7.30 for all other tenures.

The base lending rate (BLR), the lowest rate offered by a financial institution to its best customers, is being adjusted downward by a number of banks to reflect a lower average three-month interbank rate in August.
The average three-month rate in the previous month is used in BLR calculations for September under a formula introduced by Bank Negara last year.
